author: Rudeless
body:
I would like to report Minoteur for aim-bot as he never miss basically. I know how aim-bot works (i was banned :-P) so I can identify it pretty well. I do not have any evidence (I dont know how to screen record other than quick time player) but I am for sure that he uses AimBot. I belive he also uses kill aura because the chat is filled with:
username was slain by Minoteur
username was slain by Minoteur
username was slain by Minoteur
username was slain by Minoteur
etc...
Please ban him; he does not follow the rules.
